name: Evermere
subtitle: Where the Bells Fell Silent
author: Luminati
description: The hub of The Bells of Evermere: the town on its frozen lake at the blue hour of the last night of winter — the square and its silent belfry, the Halloway Forge, four roads out to the Season Bells. Generated by tools/make-bells-of-evermere.mjs.

objects.name: Agathe's Bakery
text: Warm through the door: cinnamon, and something burning slightly.

objects.name: The Weaver's House
text: A loom clacks inside, slow and patient. Whatever it is, it is very long by now.

objects.name: The Silent Bell
text: Through the door: a fiddle, badly tuned, and somebody laughing anyway.

objects.name: The Moot Hall
text: A notice on the door: NO MEETING THIS WEEK. Under it, older: NO MEETING THIS WEEK.

objects.name: Old Nettle's House
text: Somebody inside is arguing with a kettle, and winning.

objects.name: The Cooper's House
text: Barrels stacked to the rafters. Years of barrels, and nothing to put in them.

objects.name: The Chapel of the Bells
text: The chapel is cold. Seven rows of candles, all of them lit.
The well has been a solid block of ice since that night. Somebody has carved a face in it.

objects.label: Enter
locked: Not yet. Not till I know what I'm going for.

objects.label: Enter
locked: The gorge road. Seven winters of drift.

objects.label: Enter
locked: The east road. Not before the Bell of Tides.

objects.label: Enter
locked: The Frost Gate. Seven winters thick.

objects.speaker: Signpost
text: ← The Blossomwood. The Bell of Waking.

objects.speaker: Signpost
text: ↓ The gorge road to Saltcombe. The Bell of Tides.

objects.speaker: Signpost
text: → Amberfield, across the fields. The Bell of Harvest.

objects.speaker: Day board
text: Chalked under it, in a child's round hand: THE WEST BELL RANG.
objects.when: bell-waking and not bell-tides and not bell-harvest

objects.speaker: Day board
text: In chalk, in a child's round hand: THE WEST BELL RANG.
Under it, in a lamplighter's careful capitals: AND THE SOUTH ONE.

objects.speaker: Day board
text: In chalk: THE WEST BELL RANG. AND THE SOUTH ONE.
Under that, very large, the chalk snapped halfway: EAST TOO!!!
